material: UHMWPE (ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene), Celanese GUR 4120 grade data used as the property basis (UHMWPE family; implant-grade GUR 1020 is the clinical analogue, ASTM F648 / ISO 5834)

regions.implant: single body, whole mesh named 'implant' is UHMWPE

E_MPa.source: Celanese GUR 4120 datasheet as listed by Suzhou Susheng Polymer (manufacturer: Celanese Corporation): 'Tensile Modulus ... 720 MPa, ISO 527-2/1A/1' (also 703 MPa, ASTM D638, 23 C). https://sushengpolymer.com/plasmain/hIL1Se_GUR-4120 (mechanical properties table)
E_MPa.secondary_source: Goodfellow UHMWPE film group page lists tensile modulus 0.2-1.2 GPa (range contains 720 MPa): https://www.goodfellow.com/uk/uhmwpe-film-group

nu.source: Goodfellow, UHMWPE film group, material properties table: Poisson's ratio 0.46. https://www.goodfellow.com/uk/uhmwpe-film-group

strength_MPa.kind: tensile stress at yield (governing; G1 uses strength/2 = 8.5 MPa at 2x load)
strength_MPa.source: Celanese GUR 4120 datasheet as listed by Suzhou Susheng Polymer: 'Yield ... 17.0 MPa, ISO 527-2/1A/50' (ASTM D638 tensile strength at yield 21.4 MPa). https://sushengpolymer.com/plasmain/hIL1Se_GUR-4120
strength_MPa.note: The conservative ISO value (17.0) is declared, not the ASTM value (21.4).

print_scene_material: PreForm scene uses Formlabs Tough 1500 V2 (FLTO1502) on Form 4 as the printable prototype material; the intended implant material is UHMWPE. If any UHMWPE property is judged ungrounded, the scene resin (Tough 1500 V2) is the intended fallback.
